metadata.objective: Practice against five Skeletons in a free one-floor loop and leave through the east gate when ready.

combat_camps.composition: five melee Skeletons spaced around a broad clockwise or counter-clockwise practice loop

safe_zones.purpose: safe onboarding and loadout reading before entering the combat loop

special_zones.purpose: practice Dash, Sword combos, Soul Echo, and optional Relay without campaign progress
